prose.subject: Invoice INV-97206 - Stanmere Analytics
prose.body:
Dear Driftmoor Retail Team,

Please find attached our monthly invoice INV-97206 for services rendered in October. The total amount due is 3619.20 USDC.

Breakdown of charges:
- Data Processing Services: 2100.00 USDC
- API Integration Maintenance: 950.00 USDC
- Monthly Reporting Dashboard: 569.20 USDC

As per our standard payment terms, please remit payment within 30 days of receipt. You may transfer the funds to our designated account: stanmereanalytics19.testnet. Please include the invoice number in your transaction reference for accurate reconciliation.

If you have any questions regarding these line items or require a detailed report, feel free to contact our billing department at billing@stanmere-analytics.example.

Thank you for your continued partnership.

Sincerely,
Stanmere Analytics Billing Department
